subject.title: feat(plugin-sdk): onModelDiagnosticEvent for trusted model.* events

question: Should OpenClaw accept `onModelDiagnosticEvent` as a public observability-focused plugin SDK seam for trusted model diagnostics, or should this wait for a provider-scoped usage API instead?
rationale: The code blocker is mechanical, but the PR adds a new public SDK compatibility contract and adjacent provider-scoped usage work was explored but closed unmerged.

options.title: Accept narrow diagnostic seam
options.body: Proceed after the SDK surface-budget repair, keeping the API scoped to allowlisted observability/cost-attribution model diagnostics and documented as non-integrity telemetry.

options.title: Defer to provider-scoped usage
options.body: Pause or close this PR and revive a provider-owned usage feed if maintainers want usage consumers to avoid the diagnostics stream entirely.

options.title: Request a different API shape
options.body: Keep the problem open but ask for a renamed or differently scoped SDK contract before adding a public export.

recommendation.title: Accept narrow diagnostic seam
recommendation.body: Proceed after the SDK surface-budget repair, keeping the API scoped to allowlisted observability/cost-attribution model diagnostics and documented as non-integrity telemetry.

likelyOwner.reason: The diagnostic runtime SDK seam history makes this the best available owner for the public API direction call.
